comments.author: @aaronswink8554
comments.text:
I'm trying to get to Mongolia for my vacation this fall and videos like this REALLY gets me ready to go!  The entire country seems to be one scenic landscape after another.  Beautiful is too tame of a word.  Stunning?  Breathtaking?  Unreal?  
There is one correction though because I was looking to add that to the schedule - Geyser Lake, at the very end of the video, isn't in Mongolia.  It's in Russia, just across the border.  Now, Americans (not sure about other countries) can technically visit Russia.  However, it considered the highest level of danger of travel by the State Department, our credit and debit cards won't work, there are no flights, and the border can present problems.  And I really wanted to see that with my own eyes!
